# 七成的抽屉是空的

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| echo: false
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(readr)
  library(stringr)
  library(purrr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(knitr)
})

# 项目根：从当前目录逐级上溯找 assets/ 标记（与运行位置无关）
find_root <- function() {
  cur <- normalizePath(getwd(), mustWork = FALSE)
  repeat {
    if (dir.exists(file.path(cur, "assets"))) return(cur)
    up <- dirname(cur)
    if (identical(up, cur)) stop("未找到含 assets/ 的项目根目录")
    cur <- up
  }
}
root <- find_root()
source(file.path(root, "assets", "tt_theme.R"), encoding = "UTF-8")

# ---- 本周色彩（只在本周生效；共享 theme 不含任何色值）----
# 语义绑定：青柠 = 写过正文 · 珊瑚 = 只有名字 · 雾灰 = 部分写过 / 刻度与底线 · 骨白 = 主文字。
# 这三个含义在三张图里不换位：青柠永远是「有」，珊瑚永远是「没有」，雾灰永远是「介于」或刻度。
PAL <- list(
  bg    = "#0E1B21",   # 深墨青：整幅底色，像柜内背板
  lime  = "#C8F04B",   # 青柠 —— 写过正文
  coral = "#F0735D",   # 珊瑚 —— 只有名字 / 一个属整个没写
  mist  = "#8FA3AD",   # 雾灰 —— 部分写过、底线、刻度、次级注记
  bone  = "#E9F2F4"    # 骨白 —— 标题、科名、主文字
)

# ---- 本周字体决策：两族分工，打字机式标本标签 ----
# 标题 / 副标题 / 科名 = Segoe UI；所有数字与注记 = Consolas（沿自然史博物馆标签的观感）。
# 家族数 2 <= TT_FAMILY_MAX = 2。首屏 KPI 走页面自身字体栈，不参与图内决策。
FAM_T <- TT_FAMILY[["text"]]
FAM_D <- TT_FAMILY[["data"]]
mm    <- function(pt) pt / .pt          # element_text 用 pt，geom_text 用 mm

knitr::opts_chunk$set(dev = "ragg_png", dpi = TT_EXPORT$dpi,
                      dev.args = list(bg = PAL$bg))

raw <- read_csv("../data/frogs_and_toads_amphibiaweb.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# 散文式字段：能读、能算长度，但不整段进表（最长 60,805 字符）
PROSE <- c("description", "distribution", "life_history", "larva",
           "trends_and_threats", "comments")

# 抽屉底板：暗底、不画网格、不画边框，只留一条雾灰发丝底线做抽屉底 + 一把骨白中轴做抽屉脊
drawer <- function(p) {
  p +
    tt_base(bg = PAL$bg, ink = PAL$bone, body = PAL$mist,
            grid = PAL$bg, family = FAM_T) +
    theme(
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = PAL$bg, colour = NA),
      panel.border     = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.line.x      = element_line(colour = PAL$mist, linewidth = 0.3),
      axis.ticks       = element_line(colour = PAL$mist, linewidth = 0.3),
      plot.subtitle    = element_text(family = FAM_T, colour = PAL$mist,
                                      size = TT_TYPE[["subtitle"]], hjust = 0,
                                      margin = margin(b = 12)),
      plot.caption     = element_text(family = FAM_T, colour = PAL$mist,
                                      size = TT_TYPE[["caption"]], hjust = 0,
                                      margin = margin(t = 12), lineheight = 1.4),
      axis.title       = element_text(family = FAM_T, colour = PAL$mist,
                                      size = TT_TYPE[["axis_title"]]),
      axis.text        = element_text(family = FAM_D, colour = PAL$bone,
                                      size = TT_TYPE[["axis_text"]]),
      legend.text      = element_text(family = FAM_T, colour = PAL$bone,
                                      size = TT_TYPE[["annot"]]),
      legend.position  = "top",
      legend.justification = "left",
      legend.margin    = margin(b = 6),
      plot.margin      = margin(16, 20, 12, 16)
    )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: prep
#| echo: false
n_raw <- nrow(raw)
n_col <- ncol(raw)
stopifnot(n_distinct(raw$amphib_id) == n_raw)                  # 一行一个物种
stopifnot(n_distinct(raw$ordr) == 1L, raw$ordr[1] == "Anura")   # 全是无尾目

fam_cnt  <- raw |> count(family, sort = TRUE)
gen_cnt  <- raw |> count(genus, sort = TRUE)
n_fam    <- nrow(fam_cnt)
n_gen    <- nrow(gen_cnt)
id_span  <- diff(range(raw$amphib_id)) + 1
n_id_gap <- id_span - n_raw

# ---- 记录分级：六个正文式字段里有几个非空 ----
d <- raw |>
  mutate(depth = rowSums(!is.na(across(all_of(PROSE)))),
         cls   = factor(case_when(depth == 0 ~ "none",
                                  depth <= 3 ~ "partial",
                                  TRUE      ~ "full"),
                        levels = c("full", "partial", "none")))
n_none    <- sum(d$depth == 0)
n_partial <- sum(d$depth %in% 1:3)
n_full    <- sum(d$depth >= 4)
n_written <- n_raw - n_none
stopifnot(n_none + n_partial + n_full == n_raw)

# ---- 科级 ----
fam_tab <- d |>
  summarise(n = n(), written = sum(depth > 0),
            gen = n_distinct(genus), share = written / n, .by = family) |>
  arrange(desc(n))
top_fam <- fam_tab |> slice_head(n = 14)
n_top14 <- sum(top_fam$n)
cov_big <- fam_tab |> filter(n >= 100)
fam_lo  <- cov_big |> slice_min(share, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
fam_hi  <- cov_big |> slice_max(share, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
cov_ratio <- fam_hi$share / fam_lo$share
cov_cor   <- cor(cov_big$n, cov_big$share)

# ---- 属级 ----
gen_tab <- d |>
  summarise(n = n(), written = sum(depth > 0), share = written / n,
            .by = c(family, genus))
n_gen_bare <- sum(gen_tab$share == 0)
n_gen_full <- sum(gen_tab$share == 1)
n_gen_mix  <- sum(gen_tab$share > 0 & gen_tab$share < 1)

# ---- 国家：isocc 是逗号分隔的 ISO 码，一个物种可出现在多个国家 ----
ctry_pairs <- d |>
  filter(!is.na(isocc)) |>
  mutate(iso = str_split(isocc, ",")) |>
  unnest(iso) |>
  mutate(iso = str_trim(iso)) |>
  filter(nzchar(iso))
n_species_geo <- n_distinct(ctry_pairs$amphib_id)
n_pairs       <- nrow(ctry_pairs)
n_country     <- n_distinct(ctry_pairs$iso)
n_na_isocc    <- sum(is.na(d$isocc))

# ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 → 国名（只为可能入图的码手写，纯粹为了读图，不参与任何计算）
ISO_NAME <- c(BR = "Brazil", CO = "Colombia", EC = "Ecuador", PE = "Peru",
              CN = "China", MG = "Madagascar", PG = "Papua New Guinea",
              IN = "India", ID = "Indonesia", VE = "Venezuela",
              MY = "Malaysia", VN = "Vietnam")

ctry_tab <- ctry_pairs |>
  summarise(full    = sum(cls == "full"),
            partial = sum(cls == "partial"),
            none    = sum(cls == "none"),
            .by = iso) |>
  mutate(species = full + partial + none,
         share   = (full + partial) / species,
         name    = if_else(iso %in% names(ISO_NAME), ISO_NAME[iso], iso))
top12 <- ctry_tab |> arrange(desc(species)) |> slice_head(n = 12)

# 图 3 读数要用的科构成（不手打，全部现算）
ctry_fam <- ctry_pairs |>
  summarise(n = n(), wn = sum(cls != "none"), .by = c(iso, family))
pick_fam <- function(cc, k = 2) {
  ctry_fam |> filter(iso == cc) |> arrange(desc(n)) |> slice_head(n = k) |>
    mutate(share = wn / n)
}
mg_fam <- pick_fam("MG"); vn_fam <- pick_fam("VN")
mg_mant_n   <- ctry_fam$n[ctry_fam$iso == "MG" & ctry_fam$family == "Mantellidae"]
mg_mant_sh  <- ctry_fam$wn[ctry_fam$iso == "MG" & ctry_fam$family == "Mantellidae"] / mg_mant_n
n_mant_only_mg <- sum(str_detect(stats::na.omit(d$isocc[d$family == "Mantellidae"]), "^MG$"))

# ---- 署名 ----
n_sub_rows   <- sum(!is.na(d$submittedby))
n_sub_people <- n_distinct(d$submittedby)
n_sub_stub   <- sum(!is.na(d$submittedby) & d$depth == 0)
sub_tab  <- d |> filter(!is.na(submittedby)) |> count(submittedby, sort = TRUE)
sub_top  <- sub_tab |> slice_head(n = 8)
sub_dom  <- d |>
  filter(submittedby %in% sub_top$submittedby) |>
  count(submittedby, family) |>
  mutate(p = n / sum(n), .by = submittedby) |>
  slice_max(n, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE, by = submittedby)
lock1 <- sub_dom |> arrange(desc(n)) |> slice(1)

edit_tab    <- d |> filter(!is.na(editedby)) |> count(editedby, sort = TRUE)
n_edit_rows <- sum(!is.na(d$editedby))

# ---- 日期 ----
n_na_submit <- sum(is.na(d$submit_date))
n_na_edit   <- sum(is.na(d$edit_date))
n_both_date <- sum(!is.na(d$submit_date) & !is.na(d$edit_date))
n_no_date   <- sum(is.na(d$submit_date) & is.na(d$edit_date))
# 空白条目里仍然留下过编辑日期的少数行（正文要交代）
n_none_dated <- sum(d$depth == 0 & !is.na(d$edit_date))
lag_years   <- as.numeric(d$edit_date - d$submit_date)
lag_years   <- lag_years[!is.na(lag_years)] / 365.25
lag_med     <- median(lag_years)
submit_stop <- max(d$submit_date, na.rm = TRUE)
n_submit_last <- sum(format(d$submit_date, "%Y") == format(submit_stop, "%Y"),
                     na.rm = TRUE)

# ---- 异常 ----
refs_v    <- d$refs[!is.na(d$refs)]
n_refs    <- length(refs_v)
n_refs_ph <- sum(nchar(str_remove_all(refs_v, "<p>|\\s")) == 0)
desc_v    <- d$description[!is.na(d$description)]
pct_desc_html <- 100 * mean(str_detect(desc_v, "<[a-zA-Z/]"))
n_clade      <- sum(!is.na(d$clade))
n_clade_rank <- sum(unique(d$clade[!is.na(d$clade)]) %in% d$genus)
n_intro      <- sum(!is.na(d$intro_isocc))
n_intro_bad  <- sum(str_starts(d$intro_isocc[!is.na(d$intro_isocc)], ","))
n_lannoo     <- sum(!is.na(d$lannoo))
lannoo_med   <- median(nchar(d$lannoo), na.rm = TRUE)
n_intl       <- sum(!is.na(d$interntnl_status))
n_nat        <- sum(!is.na(d$national_status))
n_reg        <- sum(!is.na(d$regional_status))

# ---- 字段覆盖率（口径表用）----
field_tab <- tibble(
  field  = names(raw),
  type   = map_chr(raw, \(x) if (inherits(x, "Date")) "date"
                   else if (is.numeric(x)) "num" else "chr"),
  filled = map_int(raw, \(x) sum(!is.na(x)))
) |>
  mutate(pct = filled / n_raw) |>
  arrange(desc(pct))

# ---- 图 1：镜像条（科级）----
f1 <- top_fam |>
  mutate(none = n - written,
         y    = rev(row_number()))
f1_hi <- f1 |> slice_max(share, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
f1_lo <- f1 |> slice_min(share, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
x_cap <- max(f1$none)

# ---- 图 2：属级抖点 ----
fam_y <- f1 |> select(family, y)
g2 <- gen_tab |>
  filter(family %in% top_fam$family) |>
  left_join(fam_y, by = "family") |>
  mutate(share100 = 100 * share, bare = share == 0)
set.seed(20261013)
g2 <- g2 |>
  mutate(xj = share100 + runif(n(), -1.7, 1.7),
         yj = y + runif(n(), -0.26, 0.26))
g2_lane <- g2 |>
  summarise(gen = n(), med = median(share100), .by = c(family, y)) |>
  arrange(y)
n_gen_plotted <- nrow(g2)
big_marks <- g2 |> slice_max(n, n = 4, with_ties = FALSE) |> arrange(desc(n))

# 入图这批属的分化程度：科内离散 vs 科间离散（正文结论就靠这两个数）
n_g2_bare   <- sum(g2$share == 0)
n_g2_full   <- sum(g2$share == 1)
n_g2_mix    <- n_gen_plotted - n_g2_bare - n_g2_full
sd_within   <- mean(g2 |> summarise(s = sd(share), .by = family) |> pull(s), na.rm = TRUE)
sd_between  <- sd(g2 |> summarise(m = median(share), .by = family) |> pull(m))
rng_within  <- mean(g2 |> summarise(r = max(share) - min(share), .by = family) |> pull(r))
hyper_g     <- g2 |> filter(family == "Hyperoliidae")
strab_g     <- g2 |> filter(family == "Strabomantidae")

# ---- 图 3：国家 100% 堆叠 ----
f3 <- top12 |>
  mutate(share_pct = 100 * share) |>
  arrange(share_pct) |>
  mutate(x = row_number(),
         n_lab = format(species, big.mark = ","))
# 堆叠顺序由自己算，不依赖 position_stack 的方向：自下而上 full -> partial -> none，
# 这样青柠段贴着基线，各国覆盖率可以直接比高度；标签的 mid 与矩形用同一份累加。
CLS_UP  <- c("full", "partial", "none")
f3_long <- f3 |>
  select(x, full, partial, none) |>
  pivot_longer(c(full, partial, none), names_to = "cls", values_to = "k") |>
  mutate(cls = factor(cls, levels = CLS_UP)) |>
  group_by(x) |>
  arrange(match(cls, CLS_UP), .by_group = TRUE) |>
  mutate(sh  = k / sum(k),
         bot = cumsum(sh) - sh,
         top = cumsum(sh),
         mid = (top + bot) / 2) |>
  ungroup()
f3_lab <- f3_long |> filter(sh >= 0.07)

# ---- 溯源与自检 ----
stopifnot(
  sum(f1$written) == sum(d$depth > 0 & d$family %in% top_fam$family),
  nrow(f3_long) == 3 * nrow(f3),
  abs(sum(f3_long$sh) - nrow(f3)) < 1e-9,
  n_gen_plotted == sum(top_fam$gen),
  n_species_geo + n_na_isocc == n_raw,
  n_sub_stub == 0,
  n_no_date + 42 == n_none          # 空白条目里只有 42 行留下过日期
)

flow_f1 <- tt_flow(n_raw, n_raw, "全表入图，无剔除")
flow_f2 <- tt_flow(n_raw, n_gen_plotted,
                   sprintf("%d 个属不在入图的 14 个科里", n_gen - n_gen_plotted))
flow_f3 <- tt_flow(n_raw, n_pairs,
                   sprintf("%d 个物种没有 isocc；一个物种按 isocc 列表在每个国家各计一次，故记为「物种-国家」对而非物种数",
                           n_na_isocc))
```

<div style="display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:12px;margin:26px 0 4px;flex-wrap:wrap">
<span style="font-size:44px;font-weight:700;color:#C8F04B;line-height:1">`r sprintf("%.1f", 100 * n_none / n_raw)`%</span>
<span style="font-size:15px;color:#E9F2F4">的条目没有一句正文</span>
<span style="font-size:15px;color:#8FA3AD">·</span>
<span style="font-size:26px;font-weight:700;color:#F0735D;line-height:1">`r n_intl`</span>
<span style="font-size:15px;color:#E9F2F4">行有 IUCN 状态</span>
<span style="font-size:15px;color:#8FA3AD">·</span>
<span style="font-size:26px;font-weight:700;color:#E9F2F4;line-height:1">`r sprintf("%.1f", cov_ratio)`×</span>
<span style="font-size:15px;color:#E9F2F4">科与科之间的覆盖率差</span>
</div>

`r format(n_raw, big.mark = ",")` 行、`r n_col` 列、`r n_fam` 个科、`r n_gen` 个属——看上去像一部蛙类百科，实际上是一册**名录加 `r sprintf("%.1f", 100 * n_written / n_raw)`% 的物种志**。

其中 `r format(n_none, big.mark = ",")` 行（`r sprintf("%.1f", 100 * n_none / n_raw)`%）除了名字、科、属和分布码之外什么都没有，连作者和日期都没有。剩下 `r format(n_written, big.mark = ",")` 行写过正文。

这 `r format(n_written, big.mark = ",")` 行不是随机分布的：**一个科被写了几分，取决于当年刚好是谁在写这个科**。

这条主线决定了本页的读法：所有「差异」都是**记录口径的差异**，不是蛙类本身的差异。IUCN 那一列 `r format(n_raw, big.mark = ",")` 行全空，官方问题清单里的第三条在本快照里无法回答；`distribution` 是散文式的范围描述而不是产地坐标，所以本页也没有地图。

## 一、先把口径钉死：这是 8,018 个物种，不是一个物种的 8,018 次观察

`r flow_f1`

**粒度**：`r format(n_raw, big.mark = ",")` 行 = `r format(n_raw, big.mark = ",")` 个物种（`amphib_id` 全表唯一），全部是 `ordr == "Anura"`，落在 `r n_fam` 个科、`r n_gen` 个属里。**不是**观察记录，也不是产地坐标——一行就是一个物种条目，量的是「这个物种在档案里被写了多少」，不是「这个物种有多少」。

一个侧面的口径证据：`amphib_id` 的取值跨度是 `r format(id_span, big.mark = ",")`，而实际只有 `r format(n_raw, big.mark = ",")` 行，缺口 `r format(n_id_gap, big.mark = ",")`。原始 XML dump 在入库前被过滤成只有无尾目，缺口里既有别的目也有已撤记录；**因此不能拿 id 缺口推算物种总数**。

```{r}
#| label: tbl-fields
#| echo: false
field_tab |>
  transmute(字段 = field, 类型 = type,
            `非空行数` = format(filled, big.mark = ","),
            `非空占比` = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * pct)) |>
  kable(format = "html",
        caption = "口径表：26 个字段各自填了多少（按非空占比降序）。这张表是后面所有图的前提——空白不是 0，是「没记录」")
```

**三类字段，三种读法。**

- **标识与分类**（`amphib_id` / `ordr` / `family` / `genus` / `specificepithet` / `isocc`）：100% 或 99.6% 有值，是名录的骨架。
- **散文**（`description` / `distribution` / `life_history` / `larva` / `trends_and_threats` / `comments`）：`r sprintf("%.1f", 100 * n_written / n_raw)`% 的条目至少有一块，最多的是 `distribution`（`r format(field_tab$filled[field_tab$field == "distribution"], big.mark = ",")` 行）。
- **评估与署名**（`interntnl_status` / `national_status` / `regional_status` / `submittedby` / `edit_date`）：几乎为空。

最后一类里 `interntnl_status` 是 `r n_intl` 行有值。官方问题清单里「IUCN 状态如何在科或地区间变化」这一条，本快照没有可用数据；本页不会用别的列去凑一个替代品。

## 二、科的抽屉：写得最满的科，是最小的科

```{r}
#| label: fig-family
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Coverage across frog families runs from 9 to 90 percent, and the largest families are among the emptiest."
#| fig-width: 9.4
#| fig-height: 6.4
fig1 <- drawer(
  ggplot(f1, aes(y = y)) +
  geom_col(aes(x = -none), fill = PAL$coral, width = 0.58, orientation = "y") +
  geom_col(aes(x = written), fill = PAL$lime, width = 0.58, orientation = "y") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = PAL$bone, linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(x = -none - 26, label = format(none, big.mark = ",")),
            hjust = 1, family = FAM_D, colour = PAL$coral,
            size = mm(TT_TYPE[["annot"]])) +
  geom_text(aes(x = written + 26, label = format(written, big.mark = ",")),
            hjust = 0, family = FAM_D, colour = PAL$lime,
            size = mm(TT_TYPE[["annot"]])) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = f1$y, labels = f1$family,
                     expand = expansion(add = 0.45)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(-750, -500, -250, 0, 250, 500),
                     labels = c("750", "500", "250", "0", "250", "500"),
                     limits = c(-x_cap * 1.12, 520),
                     expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(
    title    = "The bigger the family, the emptier the drawer",
    subtitle = paste0("Top 14 families by species count; left is name only, ",
                      "right has account text"),
    x = "species in the family", y = NULL,
    caption  = tt_source("frogs_and_toads_amphibiaweb.csv", n_raw,
      sprintf(paste0("both directions share one linear scale, so a short lime side is the ",
                     "finding and not a small family; the bone line is the zero spine. Across ",
                     "the %d families with at least 100 species, coverage spans %.1f%% (%s) to ",
                     "%.1f%% (%s), a %.1f-fold gap, and its correlation with family size is ",
                     "only %.2f."),
              nrow(cov_big), 100 * fam_lo$share, fam_lo$family,
              100 * fam_hi$share, fam_hi$family, cov_ratio, cov_cor))
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(family = FAM_T, colour = PAL$bone,
                                   size = TT_TYPE[["axis_text"]]))
)
fig1
```

**读数**：入图的 14 个科占了全表 `r format(n_top14, big.mark = ",")` 行（`r sprintf("%.1f", 100 * n_top14 / n_raw)`%）。左手珊瑚条是**只有名字**的条目，右手青柠条是至少写过一块正文的条目，两侧共用一根线性轴——所以青柠条短是真的写得少，不是科小。

两极不在这 14 个科里。把 `n >= 100` 的 `r nrow(cov_big)` 个科一起看，两端是 `r fam_hi$family` 和 `r fam_lo$family`（两者排在第 15、16 位，所以不在图 1 上）。

`r fam_hi$family` 有 `r fam_hi$n` 个物种，写到 `r sprintf("%.0f", 100 * fam_hi$share)`%；`r fam_lo$family` 有 `r fam_lo$n` 个物种，只有 `r sprintf("%.0f", 100 * fam_lo$share)`%。**两端差 `r sprintf("%.1f", cov_ratio)` 倍**。

而写得最少的那一档坐着最大的两个科：Hylidae（`r format(f1$n[f1$family == "Hylidae"], big.mark = ",")` 个物种）只有 `r sprintf("%.0f", 100 * f1$share[f1$family == "Hylidae"])`% 有正文，Strabomantidae（`r format(f1$n[f1$family == "Strabomantidae"], big.mark = ",")` 个物种）只有 `r sprintf("%.0f", 100 * f1$share[f1$family == "Strabomantidae"])`%。

在 `n >= 100` 的 `r nrow(cov_big)` 个科里，科的大小与覆盖率的相关只有 `r sprintf("%.2f", cov_cor)`——**规模不买正文**。

这张图能说的：科与科之间的覆盖率差异到了十倍量级。这张图不能说的：不能反推「哪个科被研究得少」——覆盖率是**这个档案写了什么**，不是**这个类群被研究了多少**。

```{r}
#| label: tbl-family
#| echo: false
f1 |>
  arrange(desc(y)) |>
  transmute(科 = family, `属数` = gen, `物种数` = n,
            `有正文` = written, `只有名字` = none,
            `覆盖率` = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * share)) |>
  kable(format = "html",
        caption = "图 1 的原始数字（覆盖率 = 有正文 ÷ 物种数；与图上同一份聚合）")
```

## 三、科内差距比科间还大

```{r}
#| label: fig-genus
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Inside a single family some genera are fully written and others are blank, so a family average describes almost none of its genera."
#| fig-width: 9.4
#| fig-height: 6.2
fig2 <- drawer(
  ggplot(g2, aes(x = xj, y = yj)) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = bare, size = n), alpha = 0.80) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = med, xend = med, y = y - 0.30, yend = y + 0.30),
               data = g2_lane, inherit.aes = FALSE,
               colour = PAL$bone, linewidth = 0.55, lineend = "round") +
  geom_text(aes(x = if_else(share100 > 50, xj - 3.4, xj + 3.4), y = yj + 0.40,
                label = sprintf("%s (%d)", genus, n)),
            data = big_marks, inherit.aes = FALSE,
            hjust = if_else(big_marks$share100 > 50, 1, 0),
            family = FAM_D, colour = PAL$bone, size = mm(TT_TYPE[["annot"]])) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`FALSE` = PAL$lime, `TRUE` = PAL$coral),
                      labels = c(`FALSE` = "at least one account",
                                 `TRUE`  = "no account at all"),
                      name = NULL) +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 2.6, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100),
                     labels = c("0", "25", "50", "75", "100"),
                     limits = c(-4, 108), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = g2_lane$y, labels = g2_lane$family,
                     limits = c(0.35, 14.75), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(
    title    = "A family's average hides its genera",
    subtitle = paste0("Share of each genus with any account text; one dot per genus, ",
                      "laid into the same 14 families"),
    x = "share of the genus's species with account text (%)", y = NULL,
    caption  = tt_source("frogs_and_toads_amphibiaweb.csv", n_gen_plotted,
      sprintf(paste0("one dot per genus (n = %d); dot area is proportional to the number of ",
                     "species in the genus, and the bone tick marks that family's median genus. ",
                     "Inside these 14 families %d genera have no account at all, %d are fully ",
                     "written and %d are mixed, so the middle is the common case. The mean ",
                     "within-family standard deviation of genus share is %.2f, against %.2f ",
                     "between the family medians. Dots are jittered inside their lane, so a ",
                     "dense pile means many genera share that value, not a missing dot."),
              n_gen_plotted, n_g2_bare, n_g2_full, n_g2_mix, sd_within, sd_between))
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(family = FAM_T, colour = PAL$bone,
                                   size = TT_TYPE[["axis_text"]]))
)
fig2
```

**读数**：入图的 `r n_gen_plotted` 个属里，`r n_g2_bare` 个一个条目都没写过（全表 `r n_gen_bare` 个），`r n_g2_full` 个写得一个不剩（全表 `r n_gen_full` 个），其余 `r n_g2_mix` 个是半写不写。所以这里**不是**清晰的两层结构——中间地带才是多数。

真正值得注意的是离散程度：**科内的属级离散和科间一样大**。属级覆盖率的科内标准差平均 `r sprintf("%.2f", sd_within)`，而科中位数之间的标准差只有 `r sprintf("%.2f", sd_between)`。

平均每个科内部，最高与最低的属差 `r sprintf("%.0f", 100 * rng_within)` 个百分点。`r f1_hi$family` 的中位属写到 `r sprintf("%.0f", g2_lane$med[g2_lane$family == f1_hi$family])`%，它内部完全空白的属是 `r sum(hyper_g$share == 0)` 个（共 `r nrow(hyper_g)` 个属）；`r f1_lo$family` 的中位属只有 `r sprintf("%.0f", g2_lane$med[g2_lane$family == f1_lo$family])`%，它的 `r nrow(strab_g)` 个属里也有 `r sum(strab_g$share > 0)` 个写过。

结论因此要说得比「科」精确：**同一科里的属可以完全不在一个状态上，所以拿科平均值去描述这批记录会抹掉真实的差异**。四个最大的属（`r paste(sprintf("%s %d", big_marks$genus, big_marks$n), collapse = " / ")`）加起来 `r format(sum(big_marks$n), big.mark = ",")` 个物种，占全表 `r sprintf("%.1f", 100 * sum(big_marks$n) / n_raw)`%，覆盖率从 `r sprintf("%.0f", min(big_marks$share100))`% 到 `r sprintf("%.0f", max(big_marks$share100))`%——最大的属反而最空，这一条与第一节的科级规律方向一致。

要说清的一句：这张图**不能**证明「按属写作」是有意的编辑政策。它只说明可观察到的结果是属级的——原因可能是通才式的写作习惯，也可能是稿件本来就按属分工。下一节给出一个更具体的线索。

```{r}
#| label: tbl-genus
#| echo: false
g2 |>
  arrange(desc(y), desc(n)) |>
  transmute(科 = family, 属 = genus, `物种数` = n, `有正文` = written,
            `覆盖率` = sprintf("%.1f%%", share100)) |>
  kable(format = "html",
        caption = "图 2 的原始数字（每个属一行；「有正文」= 该属里有正文的物种数）")
```

## 四、地图是国家，机制是科

```{r}
#| label: fig-country
#| echo: false
#| fig-cap: "Country coverage follows taxonomic composition rather than national effort: the best-covered bar is a one-family island."
#| fig-width: 9.4
#| fig-height: 5.9
fig3 <- drawer(
  ggplot(f3_long) +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = x - 0.33, xmax = x + 0.33, ymin = bot, ymax = top, fill = cls),
            colour = PAL$bg, linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = PAL$mist, linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_text(aes(x = x, y = mid, label = sprintf("%.0f", 100 * sh)),
            data = f3_lab, inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = PAL$bg,
            family = FAM_D, fontface = "bold",
            size = mm(TT_TYPE[["annot"]])) +
  geom_text(aes(x = x, y = 1.03, label = n_lab), data = f3, inherit.aes = FALSE,
            family = FAM_D, colour = PAL$mist, size = mm(TT_TYPE[["caption"]]),
            vjust = 0) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(full = PAL$lime, partial = PAL$mist, none = PAL$coral),
                    breaks = c("full", "partial", "none"),
                    labels = c("4-6 blocks written", "1-3 blocks", "name only")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = f3$x, labels = f3$name,
                     limits = c(0.35, 12.65), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, .5, 1), labels = c("0", "50", "100"),
                     limits = c(0, 1.09), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(
    title    = "Geography is a shadow of taxonomy",
    subtitle = paste0("Native-range countries with the most records, ",
                      "stacked by how much of each was written"),
    x = NULL, y = "share of the country's species records (%)",
    caption  = tt_source("frogs_and_toads_amphibiaweb.csv", n_pairs,
      sprintf(paste0("each bar counts species-country pairs, not species: the %s records ",
                     "spread over %d countries as %s pairs, and a species appears once per ",
                     "country in its isocc list. Bars are ordered by coverage and the number ",
                     "above each bar is its species count. Coral and mist are absent text, ",
                     "not a zero count. isocc is a country-code list, not point localities, ",
                     "so no map is drawn."),
              format(n_raw, big.mark = ","), n_country, format(n_pairs, big.mark = ",")))
  )
) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(family = FAM_T, colour = PAL$bone,
                                   size = TT_TYPE[["axis_text"]],
                                   angle = 32, hjust = 1))
fig3
```

`r flow_f3`

**读数**：`r format(n_species_geo, big.mark = ",")` 个有 `isocc` 的物种摊到 `r n_country` 个国家，共 `r format(n_pairs, big.mark = ",")` 个「物种—国家」对。入图的 12 个国家里，`r f3$name[f3$x == 12]`（`r format(f3$species[f3$x == 12], big.mark = ",")` 个物种记录）覆盖率 `r sprintf("%.0f", f3$share_pct[f3$x == 12])`% 最高，`r f3$name[f3$x == 1]`（`r format(f3$species[f3$x == 1], big.mark = ",")` 个）最低，`r sprintf("%.0f", f3$share_pct[f3$x == 1])`%。

但这根梯度不是「各国努力程度」的梯度，而是科构成的梯度。**国家的覆盖率是科构成的影子**：同一批国家换个科组成，覆盖率就会跟着换。

`r f3$name[f3$x == 12]` 那一端是 `r mg_fam$family[1]`——`r format(f3$species[f3$x == 12], big.mark = ",")` 条记录里 `r mg_fam$n[1]` 条属于这个科。而这个科全表只有 `r format(fam_tab$n[fam_tab$family == "Mantellidae"], big.mark = ",")` 个物种，其中 `r n_mant_only_mg` 个只记在这一个国家，写过 `r sprintf("%.0f", 100 * mg_mant_sh)`%。

`r f3$name[f3$x == 1]` 那一端则主要由 `r vn_fam$family[1]`（`r vn_fam$n[1]` 条，`r sprintf("%.0f", 100 * vn_fam$share[1])`% 写过）与 `r vn_fam$family[2]`（`r vn_fam$n[2]` 条，`r sprintf("%.0f", 100 * vn_fam$share[2])`% 写过）组成——两个物种数不少、正文很少的科。

这张图不能说的：不能读成「某国资料更全」。`isocc` 只是范围代码，没有产地坐标、没有记录数、没有调查强度，物种数多不等于野外多。

```{r}
#| label: tbl-country
#| echo: false
f3 |>
  arrange(desc(x)) |>
  transmute(国家 = name, `ISO` = iso, `物种记录数` = species,
            `4-6 块` = full, `1-3 块` = partial, `只有名字` = none,
            `覆盖率` = sprintf("%.1f%%", share_pct)) |>
  kable(format = "html",
        caption = "图 3 的原始数字（按覆盖率降序；「物种记录数」= 该国的物种—国家对数）")
```

## 五、是谁写的，以及这份档案的年龄

```{r}
#| label: tbl-pens
#| echo: false
sub_top |>
  left_join(sub_dom, by = "submittedby") |>
  mutate(`主笔的科` = sprintf("%s (%d, %.0f%%)", family, n.y, 100 * p)) |>
  transmute(署名者 = submittedby, `条目数` = n.x,
            `占已署名条目` = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * n.x / n_sub_rows),
            `主笔的科` = `主笔的科`) |>
  kable(format = "html",
        caption = "署名最多的 8 位（submittedby）：一个名字基本等于一个科")
```

**笔是分科的。** `r format(n_sub_rows, big.mark = ",")` 行有 `submittedby`，而且全部落在写过正文的条目里——有署名却空白的条目 `r n_sub_stub` 行。署名与写作在这份数据里是同一件事。

`r n_sub_people` 个署名里，前 3 位写了 `r format(sum(sub_tab$n[1:3]), big.mark = ",")` 条，占已署名的 `r sprintf("%.1f", 100 * sum(sub_tab$n[1:3]) / n_sub_rows)`%；前 10 位占 `r sprintf("%.1f", 100 * sum(sub_tab$n[1:10]) / n_sub_rows)`%。

而每位主笔的条目几乎集中在同一个科：`r lock1$submittedby` 的 `r lock1$n` 条里，有 `r sprintf("%.0f", 100 * lock1$p)`% 落在 `r lock1$family`。

这解释了第二、三节的两头：Hyperoliidae 覆盖率 `r sprintf("%.0f", 100 * fam_tab$share[fam_tab$family == "Hyperoliidae"])`% 不是因为它被格外重视，而是因为有一位作者整科写过它；Strabomantidae 的 `r sprintf("%.0f", 100 * fam_tab$share[fam_tab$family == "Strabomantidae"])`% 也不是没人管，而是没有人整科接手。这是**分工与相关**的陈述，不是因果推断：数据里没有任何一列写着「为什么」。

```{r}
#| label: tbl-vintage
#| echo: false
tibble(
  项 = c("submit_date 最早 / 最晚", "submit_date 为空",
         "edit_date 最早 / 最晚", "edit_date 为空",
         "两个日期都有", "两个日期都没有",
         "两者都有时的中位滞后",
         "被编辑次数最多的三个人"),
  值 = c(sprintf("%s / %s", format(min(d$submit_date, na.rm = TRUE)), format(submit_stop)),
         sprintf("%s 行（%.1f%%）", format(n_na_submit, big.mark = ","),
                 100 * n_na_submit / n_raw),
         sprintf("%s / %s", format(min(d$edit_date, na.rm = TRUE)),
                 format(max(d$edit_date, na.rm = TRUE))),
         sprintf("%s 行（%.1f%%）", format(n_na_edit, big.mark = ","),
                 100 * n_na_edit / n_raw),
         sprintf("%s 行", format(n_both_date, big.mark = ",")),
         sprintf("%s 行（%.1f%%）", format(n_no_date, big.mark = ","),
                 100 * n_no_date / n_raw),
         sprintf("%.1f 年（n = %s）", lag_med, format(length(lag_years), big.mark = ",")),
         sprintf("%s %d / %s %d / %s %d",
                 edit_tab$editedby[1], edit_tab$n[1],
                 edit_tab$editedby[2], edit_tab$n[2],
                 edit_tab$editedby[3], edit_tab$n[3]))
) |>
  kable(format = "html",
        caption = "这份档案自己的时间线（注意：两个日期都为空的那批条目，几乎就是空白条目）")
```

**档案的年龄不是一条平滑的线。** 条目最后一次被编辑的时间跨 `r format(min(d$edit_date, na.rm = TRUE), "%Y")`–`r format(max(d$edit_date, na.rm = TRUE), "%Y")`。

可两个日期都没有的是 `r format(n_no_date, big.mark = ",")` 行（`r sprintf("%.1f", 100 * n_no_date / n_raw)`%），而这批行几乎就是空白条目本身：`r format(n_none, big.mark = ",")` 行空白条目里只有 `r n_none_dated` 行留下过日期。

所以「记录深度」与「有没有日期」几乎是同一个变量。**不能**把编辑年份当成独立的时间轴去做趋势——那会变成只对 `r sprintf("%.1f", 100 * n_written / n_raw)`% 的样本做时间分析。

对 `r format(n_both_date, big.mark = ",")` 个两个日期都有的条目，从提交到最近一次编辑的中位滞后是 `r sprintf("%.1f", lag_med)` 年——这批条目在档案里躺了很久才被补写。`submit_date` 到 `r format(submit_stop, "%Y")` 只剩 `r n_submit_last` 条，之后的新条目基本只留编辑日期；这是录入口径的变化，不是收录的停止。

## 数据异常（记录，不改数据）

| 现象 | 原始数字 | 处理 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| IUCN 状态列全空 | `interntnl_status` `r format(n_raw, big.mark = ",")` 行、`r n_intl` 个非空（该列因此被读成 logical） | 不填补、不拿 `national_status` / `regional_status` 冒充；官方问题第三条明确写成「本快照无此数据」 |
| 国家级 / 地区级状态是自由文本 | `national_status` `r n_nat` 行、`regional_status` `r n_reg` 行，取值含 `None` / `N/A` / `Unknown` / `California` / `CALIFORNIA` | 不做任何评级汇总；大小写不一致说明是手工录入 |
| `refs` 大部分是占位符 | `r format(n_refs, big.mark = ",")` 个非空里 `r format(n_refs_ph, big.mark = ",")` 个去掉 `<p>` 后没有任何内容，真正含链接或 DOI 的只有 `r format(n_refs - n_refs_ph, big.mark = ",")` 个 | 不计入记录分级；正文不用 `refs` 判断「被研究过」 |
| 散文字段是 HTML 片段 | `description` 非空行里 `r sprintf("%.0f", pct_desc_html)`% 含 `<i>` / `<p>` 等标签 | 只算长度与是否为空，不解析、不截断入表；也不剥离（剥离会改变原文） |
| `clade` 不是一个「支系」列 | `r format(n_clade, big.mark = ",")` 个非空，取值只有 57 种，其中 `r n_clade_rank` 个是表内的**属名**，其余是亚科名，混了分类阶元 | 全页不使用；分类一律用 `family` / `subfamily` / `genus` |
| `intro_isocc`（引入地）格式残留 | `r n_intro` 个非空里 `r n_intro_bad` 个以逗号开头（如 `",BR"`） | 不参与入图；只记下「分布码拼接」这一事实 |
| `isocc` 有 `r n_na_isocc` 个物种为空 | `r n_na_isocc` 行 | 图 3 的 n 用「物种—国家」对并写明差额；不把它们当「零分布」 |
| `lannoo` 是巨型转移文本 | 只有 `r n_lannoo` 行，中位长度 `r format(round(lannoo_med), big.mark = ",")` 字符（最长 60,805） | 完全不进表、不进字长统计，否则整表被这 96 行撑爆 |
| `amphib_id` 有缺口 | 跨度 `r format(id_span, big.mark = ",")`，实有 `r format(n_raw, big.mark = ",")` 行，缺 `r format(n_id_gap, big.mark = ",")` | 不用 id 推算物种数（缺口含别的目与已撤记录） |
| 空白条目几乎都没日期 | 两个日期都空 `r format(n_no_date, big.mark = ",")` 行；`r format(n_none, big.mark = ",")` 行空白条目里只有 `r n_none_dated` 行留下过日期 | 正文明确「时间维度只覆盖有日期的子集」；不把空日期读成「很久以前」，也不把这 `r n_none_dated` 行当成有时间信息的条目 |
| `submittedby` 是自由文本 | 含 "et. al."、机构式合并（`Miguel Vences and Frank Glaw`）、重音字符（`Schiøtz`） | 按原文精确匹配计数，不做人名归并、不做音译 |

## 方法与口径

| 项 | 值 |
| --- | --- |
| 数据 | `data/frogs_and_toads_amphibiaweb.csv`（`r format(n_raw, big.mark = ",")` × `r n_col`，`amphib_id` 唯一，全部 `ordr == "Anura"`） |
| 覆盖 | `r n_fam` 个科 / `r n_gen` 个属 / `r n_country` 个 `isocc` 国家码 / `r n_sub_people` 个 `submittedby` 署名 |
| 入图样本 | 图 1：`r flow_f1`；图 2：`r flow_f2`；图 3：`r flow_f3` |
| 「有正文」的定义 | 六个散文式字段（`description` / `distribution` / `life_history` / `larva` / `trends_and_threats` / `comments`）中至少一个非空；`refs` 与 `relation_to_humans` 不计入（前者多为占位符，后者只有 308 行） |
| 记录分级 | `full` = 6 个字段里 4–6 个非空（`r format(n_full, big.mark = ",")` 行）· `partial` = 1–3 个（`r format(n_partial, big.mark = ",")` 行）· `none` = 0 个（`r format(n_none, big.mark = ",")` 行） |
| 图 1 口径 | 按 `family` 聚合，取物种数最多的 14 个科（占 `r sprintf("%.1f", 100 * n_top14 / n_raw)`%）；左右共用一根线性轴，左为「只有名字」、右为「有正文」；标签是原始行数 |
| 图 2 口径 | 按「科 × 属」聚合，只取图 1 那 14 个科内的 `r n_gen_plotted` 个属；纵轴是同一批科，横轴是该属里有正文的物种占比；点面积 ∝ 属内物种数；点在行内抖动，重叠表示密集而非缺漏 |
| 图 3 口径 | 把 `isocc` 按逗号拆开，一个物种按其列表在每个国家各计一次（`r format(n_pairs, big.mark = ",")` 对）；取物种记录最多的 12 个国家，按覆盖率排序；每根条是 100% 堆叠的三级记录分级 |
| 不作为证据的列 | `interntnl_status`（全空）、`clade`（阶元混杂）、`national_status` / `regional_status`（自由文本）、`lannoo`（`r n_lannoo` 行巨型文本）、`refs`（`r sprintf("%.0f", 100 * n_refs_ph / n_refs)`% 是占位符）；这些列都不能用来判断「某个类群被研究了多少」 |
| 不画的东西 | 不画世界地图（`isocc` 是国家码列表，没有坐标，画地图会把「档案覆盖」误读成「分布密度」）；不画编辑年份趋势（空白条目几乎全无日期，任何时间轴都只覆盖 `r sprintf("%.1f", 100 * n_written / n_raw)`% 的样本）；不做 IUCN 分析（`r n_intl` 行可用）；不按国家排名下结论（国家覆盖差异主要是科构成差异，见第四节） |
| 数字来源 | 正文所有数字来自本页 prep chunk 的同一份聚合；内联数字一律经 `sprintf` / `format` 定型，避开 knitr 对大数的科学计数法改写 |

```{r}
#| label: typography-audit
#| include: false
audit <- bind_rows(
  tt_audit(fig1) |> mutate(图 = "图 1", .before = 1),
  tt_audit(fig2) |> mutate(图 = "图 2", .before = 1),
  tt_audit(fig3) |> mutate(图 = "图 3", .before = 1)
)
n_size_used <- n_distinct(audit$size[!is.na(audit$size)])
n_family    <- n_distinct(audit$family[!is.na(audit$family)])
n_off       <- sum(!audit$in_ladder)
stopifnot(n_size_used <= TT_TYPE_MAX, n_family <= TT_FAMILY_MAX, n_off == 0)
cat(sprintf("typo-audit: sizes %d/%d, families %d/%d, off-ladder %d\n",
            n_size_used, TT_TYPE_MAX, n_family, TT_FAMILY_MAX, n_off), file = stderr())
```
